Subject: Action: reconcile MedVantage SF stages & finalize close windows

Hi Sofia / MedVantage team —

Quick nudge from the forecast hygiene side. Finance ran a pull of open opportunities linked to your account and there are a handful with mismatched stages and close-date ranges that will materially affect our Q4 cadence if not reconciled. I've attached the export with a single column called "action_needed" where we highlighted:
- stale close dates (older than 90 days)
- opportunities in "Verbal" / "Negotiation" without contract milestone
- deals with no owner assigned in Salesforce

Could you help confirm for the items in the export whether:
1) The close date in SF should be moved to the quarter shown, or
2) The opportunity should be marked as "On Hold" / "Withdrawn" if it's no longer active, or
3) Assign an internal owner/contact for procurement follow-up

We're proposing a two-week lock window: if not confirmed by Oct 21 PDT we'll move the items flagged as "stale" to "On Hold" so our forecast reflects realistic capacity for Q4 planning. If that timeline doesn't work, tell us what does and we'll adjust.

Attachments:
- medvantage_opps_export_20271014.csv (text/csv)
- mutual_action_plan_MEDV-0913.pdf (application/pdf)

Link to MAP and evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-MVP-MAP

Thanks — appreciate the quick confirmation so finance can close the book on Q4 assumptions.

— Logan

If we don't see owner assignment and clear next-step evidence by Oct 21 I'll flag these to sales leadership for manual recategorization. Finance needs the clean signal for FY planning.
